# Awesome SEO & GEO Skills

[中文](README.md) · **English**

> A curated list of agent skills for SEO and GEO (generative engine optimization): keyword research, content optimization, technical audits and rank tracking, plus getting cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Chinese AI assistants such as Doubao, Yuanbao and Kimi. Install them into Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Qwen, Doubao or WorkBuddy.

This list collects SEO and GEO skills for AI agents. SEO gets you ranked by search engines; GEO gets you mentioned and cited in AI answers. Most use the standard SKILL.md format, so any agent that supports skills can install them; see the [FAQ](#faq). Every project was checked by hand and scanned by a script before it was listed, and is sorted by job and by the search engine or AI platform it targets. Chinese AI search (Doubao, Yuanbao, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen) has its own section.

76 skill projects + 5 MCP servers and CLI tools · metadata updated 2026-10-19

**Legend**: 🌟 featured · 📝 prompt files (not a standard skill) · 🔌 MCP server or CLI tool · 🧩 full app · 💤 not updated for 180+ days · 📦 archived · ⚠️ repo unavailable

**Let your agent choose**: this list is also a skill. Run `npx skills add UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-seo-geo-skills` to install seo-geo-skill-finder, then ask your agent "I want ChatGPT and Perplexity to cite my docs site. Which skill should I install?"

> [!NOTE]
> "Checked by hand" means the README, directory structure and classification were reviewed; it does not mean the output was tested. The script scan looks for binaries and archives, install hooks, remote code execution and reads of sensitive files, and lists the network addresses in scripts. A clean scan does not prove a skill is safe.

Optimization for Chinese AI assistants and Baidu. Their crawling differs from English AI search: GitHub blocks ByteDance's crawler, for example, so Doubao can hardly read GitHub pages directly and off-site content matters.

Crawl audits, structured data, sitemaps, page speed and indexing issues.

- 🌟 **[web-quality-skills](https://github.com/addyosmani/web-quality-skills)** · ★ 3k<br>Measurement-first web quality skills from Addy Osmani: performance, accessibility, best practices and SEO based on Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals and Chrome DevTools for agents.<br><sub>Targets: Google</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-08-24 · English · 6 skills · MIT</sub>

- **[seo-ops](https://github.com/tigerless-labs/seo-ops)** · ★ 809<br>SEO foundation checks as a skill: give it a URL and it fetches the site like a crawler, runs 26 deterministic structural checks and returns a pass/fail report with evidence. No LLM involved.<br><sub>Targets: Any engine</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-01 · English · 2 skills</sub>

- **[seo-audit-skill](https://github.com/JeffLi1993/seo-audit-skill)** · ★ 766<br>Single-page SEO audits for OpenClaw, Claude Code and other agents: give it a URL and get an HTML report, with scripts for deterministic checks and the LLM for intent and quality, at beginner and advanced levels.<br><sub>Targets: Google</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-06-17 · Multilingual · 2 skills · MIT</sub>

- **[seo-skills/seo-audit-skill](https://github.com/seo-skills/seo-audit-skill)** · ★ 632<br>SEOmator audit: scans any site against 373 rules in 20 categories, from technical SEO and Core Web Vitals to structured data, security headers and AI search readiness, as a CLI, desktop app and Claude Code skill.<br><sub>Targets: Any engine</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-15 · English · 2 skills · MIT</sub>

- **[Seo-Promt-Master](https://github.com/umutxyp/Seo-Promt-Master)** · ★ 563<br>Google's SEO documentation as an audit skill: maps every public route in your project, checks each page against the rules of Google, Bing, Yandex, Apple and AI crawlers, and fixes the gaps step by step.<br><sub>Targets: Google · Bing</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-17 · English · MIT</sub>

- **[seo-geo-audit](https://github.com/dageno-agents/seo-geo-audit)** · ★ 176<br>Professional SEO and GEO audit workflows for brands, SaaS teams, SEO operators, agencies and AI-search growth teams.<br><sub>Targets: Google · Bing · ChatGPT · Perplexity · Gemini · Google AI Overviews</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-08-19 · Multilingual · MIT</sub>

- **[seo-landing](https://github.com/aleksandr-alhoff/seo-landing)** · ★ 171<br>Gives your coding agent a senior technical SEO engineer's skills for landing pages: a 100/100 PageSpeed target, Core Web Vitals, full Schema.org structured data and AVIF images.<br><sub>Targets: Google</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-08-30 · English · MIT</sub>

- **[claude-code-seo](https://github.com/huifer/claude-code-seo)** · ★ 111<br>Next.js SEO assistant plugin for Claude Code: 100-point audits across six dimensions covering metadata, structured data, E-E-A-T, content strategy, local SEO and backlinks, with separate advice for Chinese and English sites.<br><sub>Targets: Google</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-01-04 💤 · Chinese · 12 skills · MIT</sub>

- **[jdevalk/skills](https://github.com/jdevalk/skills)** · ★ 107<br>Skills from Yoast founder Joost de Valk that audit and improve your GitHub presence, WordPress.org plugin pages, Astro and static-site SEO and the readability of your writing, each producing drop-in replacements.<br><sub>Targets: Any engine</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-07-05 · English · 12 skills · MIT</sub>

- **[squirrelscan/skills](https://github.com/squirrelscan/skills)** · ★ 101<br>Skills for squirrelscan, a website audit tool for coding agents: crawls the site, checks every page against 300+ rules across SEO, performance, security, accessibility and content, and returns fixable issues.<br><sub>Targets: Any engine</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-16 · English · 2 skills · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 Requires the squirrelscan CLI and an account; usage runs on credits.</sub>

- **[claude-seo-ai](https://github.com/Hainrixz/claude-seo-ai)** · ★ 77<br>Audits any site on two separate scores — classic search SEO and AI visibility (GEO/AEO) — and can apply the safe fixes for you if you opt in.<br><sub>Targets: Google · ChatGPT · Perplexity · Gemini · Claude · Google AI Overviews</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-07 · English · 34 skills · MIT</sub>

<a id="group-offsite"></a>
### Backlinks, PR and off-site mentions

AI answers often cite third-party pages such as news coverage, directories, forums and reviews. These skills build backlinks, pitch the press and earn off-site mentions.

- **[newsjack](https://github.com/elvisun/newsjack)** · ★ 1.6k<br>Open-source skills that turn your agent into a PR team: monitor your space for newsjacking opportunities, check whether a story is still fresh, generate angles, fact-check and write for AI visibility.<br><sub>Targets: ChatGPT · Claude</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-19 · English · 32 skills · MIT</sub>

- **[backlink_skills](https://github.com/flaqai/backlink_skills)** · ★ 788<br>Backlink submission workflow from Flaq AI: a channel list and product-directory submission skills that check each channel first, submit only with your authorization, hand captchas to you and keep evidence.<br><sub>Targets: Google</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-15 · Multilingual · 15 skills · MIT</sub>

- **[distribb-skill](https://github.com/Bomx/distribb-skill)** · ★ 200<br>Distribb's SEO skill: write content with your own AI and publish through Distribb's backlink network, with keyword data, a Search Console audit, CMS publishing and Google Business Profile management.<br><sub>Targets: Google</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-11 · English · 2 skills</sub><br><sub>💡 Distribb is a paid service.</sub>

- **[qwoted-seo-backlinks-skill](https://github.com/Bomx/qwoted-seo-backlinks-skill)** · ★ 148<br>Finds PR and backlink opportunities on Qwoted, builds a sourced statistics page as a linkable asset and pitches journalists from your agent.<br><sub>Targets: Any engine</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-05-02 · English</sub><br><sub>💡 Requires a Qwoted account.</sub>

<a id="faq"></a>
## FAQ

### What is GEO, and how is it different from SEO?

SEO (search engine optimization) gets your pages ranked by search engines such as Google and Bing. GEO (generative engine optimization, also called AEO) gets you mentioned and cited in AI answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and others. They overlap: AI search usually starts from search engine results, so good SEO is the base of GEO. But AI answers care more about passages they can quote directly, clear sources, and how often other sites mention you. GEO-focused projects are under [GEO: get cited in AI answers](#group-geo) (20).

### What are the best agent skills for SEO?

This list has 76 hand-checked SEO and GEO skill projects (data updated 2026-10-19). For one system that covers most of the work, start with [All-in-one](#group-pipeline) (15); the most-starred are [marketingskills](https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills), [claude-seo](https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/claude-seo) and [notfair-plugin](https://github.com/nowork-studio/notfair-plugin). For a single step, go to the keywords and ranking data, content, technical audit or backlinks sections.

### Do these skills need paid SEO data?

It depends. Skills that rely only on the model and page fetching don't. Those that look up search volume, backlinks or rankings usually need Search Console (free) or a paid API such as Ahrefs, Semrush or DataForSEO; each entry says what it needs.

### What about Chinese AI assistants and Baidu?

Projects built for them are under [Chinese AI search](#group-cn-ai) (5); some in other sections also cover Doubao or Kimi, and 7 in total explicitly target Doubao. Chinese assistants crawl differently from English AI search: GitHub's robots.txt blocks ByteDance's crawler (Bytespider), for example, so Doubao can hardly read GitHub pages directly and relies on off-site content such as WeChat articles, Zhihu and Toutiao. See [By search engine and AI platform](#by-engines).

### Are these projects safe to install?

Every repo was checked by hand (README, folders and files) and scanned by a script for binaries and archives, install hooks, remote code execution and reads of sensitive files. 76 skill projects and 5 tools made the list. Repos that were reviewed and turned down are recorded with the reason in [data/ignore.toml](data/ignore.toml) (in Chinese; 34 so far). A clean scan does not prove a skill is safe, so read its `SKILL.md` and scripts before installing.

### How often is the list updated?

Every Monday, stars, last-updated dates and licenses refresh automatically and new repos are searched; new repos are added only after a manual check. See [New this week](#new).
